title: Backpack
hook: Dora 得到一个新背包，背包里什么都有。她要过桥、爬大石、去图书馆，一路上背包帮了大忙。

cells.en: “This is a very special Backpack, Dora,” says the big Backpack.
cells.cn: 大背包说：“Dora，这是一个很特别的小背包。”

cells.en: “I'm going to take you with me wherever I go,” says Dora.
cells.cn: Dora 说：“不管我去哪儿，都要带着你。”

cells.en: The Map says, “Bridge, Rock, Library.” That is the way.
cells.cn: 地图说：“桥、大石头、图书馆。”这就是路线。

cells.en: “To cut through the net, use a pair of scissors,” says Backpack.
cells.cn: 背包说：“要剪开网子，就用一把剪刀。”

cells.en: Swiper laughs, “They'll never get it, they'll never get it!”
cells.cn: Swiper 笑着说：“他们永远拿不到，永远拿不到！”

cells.en: “Do you know where I can find a rope?” a friend asks.
cells.cn: 一位朋友问：“你知道我在哪儿能找到绳子吗？”

cells.en: “Will you help us slide down the big rock?” asks Boots.
cells.cn: Boots 问：“你愿意帮我们从大石头上滑下去吗？”

cells.en: At the Library, someone asks, “Do you remember where I put the books?”
cells.cn: 在图书馆里，有人问：“你记得我把书放哪儿了吗？”

cells.en: “Backpack helped us, hooray!” Everyone cheers for the new Backpack.
cells.cn: “背包帮了我们，万岁！”大家一起为新背包欢呼。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Backpack”.
ending: In the end, Backpack helps Dora and her friends at the Library. My favorite part is ______.
